correctness.rationale: CRT identifies independent Bernoulli indicators of local divisibility: for a uniform residue, P(p|n)=1/p with signs chi4(p), and for two uniform units, P(p|u²+v²)=2/(p-1) if p≡1 (mod 4) and zero otherwise. Mertens in classes 1 and 3 (mod 4) gives H→∞ and bounded signed harmonic sum. Fixed-t logarithmic mgfs are H(cosh t−1)+O_t(1) and H(e^t−1)+O_t(1), including first two derivatives. Chernoff tilts t=asinh(1/2) and t=−ln2 give upper exponential bounds; Lindeberg CLTs for bounded independent tilted Bernoulli arrays with variance asymptotic to positive multiples of H yield matching lower bounds on intervals of width H^(2/3). Exact fractions CRT verification supports but does not prove the asymptotics.
